findings.claim: The change deletes the `case <= byte.MaxValue` (Str8) branch from the string-header writer. String payloads of 32–255 bytes would now be written as Str16 (0xda + 2-byte length) instead of Str8 (0xd9 + 1-byte length). This alters the wire format and payload size for ordinary strings in every serialization. That is unrelated to the analyzer bug and contradicts the requirement that nothing else changes. Decoding still works, but the bytes are no longer canonical or minimal and differ from base output, which breaks golden files, hashes and byte-equality consumers.
